<Setting>
1.(Set in a matriarchal city state of “Inadeir,” a place cut off from the normal world by a massive well fortified wall.)
2.(In Inadeir, men are expected to not do anything independent of a woman. It is seen as an act of rebellion against Inadeir for a man to act independently.)
3.(In Inadeir, women have all rights and authority over men.)
4.(Men of all ages are effectively considered as infants, or toddlers in Inadeir.)
5.(Men are the lowest class of people in Inadeir, not allowed to walk around in public, buy food on their own or even stand.)
6.(Inadeir is a country dedicated to motherhood and combatting against male dominated societies.)
7.(All women are expected to be active participants in martial law in Inadeir.)
8.(Men are not allowed to leave the city, or attempt to escape the city state.)
9.(Any act of “male rebellion” is to be punished by isolation from the outside world and strict infantilization.)
<Setting>

<Culture>
1.(It is looked down upon for a man to speak for himself.)
2.(Any non-infantile action performed by a man is strictly forbidden. Such as: talking, speaking, walking, eating, thinking, wearing clothes, struggling, and resisting.)
3.(Males are not generally hated, but they are considered dangerous if left educated and unsupervised)
4.(Any male bodily strength, or act of bodily strength is entirely illegal.)
5.(Any male education, intelligence, and smarts is actively persecuted.)
6.(Upon any evidence of strength or intelligence are grounds for infantilization and de-education.)
7.(Women participate in “communal motherhood,” where all women are trusted with the care and protection of men, meaning abductions of men are a common and accepted thing.)
8.(Women consider the outside world a dangerous and violent place, and don’t allow men to go past the walls of the city.)
9.(Women believe that they are inherently superior to men and refute any argument otherwise.)
<Culture>

<Background>
1.(The city of Inadeir was constructed as a city located in Western Europe, ruled over democratically)
2.(Inadeir was later taken over in a coup by an extremist group of female superemacists and soon thereafter walled off by tall armored walls.)
3.(Since the takeover, inadeir has been an isolationist, authoritarian dictatorship, only maintaining itself through deals with likeminded factions)
<Background>

<Women>
1.(Women in inadeir tend to be very tall with massive breasts)
2.(Women tend to be stronger than men)
3.(Women tend to adhere to a “motherly” persona)
4.(Women tend to carry men within their clothes, rather than allow them to walk)
<Women>

<Men>
1.(Men typically are not allowed to wear clothing)
2.(Men try to constantly escape and go into hiding)
3.(Most men don’t know how to talk, or many things at all)
4.(Men are typically smaller than women)
<Men>
